name: @santi020k/lumen-motion
description: Local Lumen product animations and social video compositions.

scripts.build: pnpm run prepare:assets && astro build && node scripts/prepare-compositions.mjs
scripts.check:composition: HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes check dist/portrait --strict && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes check dist/landscape --strict
scripts.render:portrait: HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes render dist --composition portrait/index.html --output renders/one-interface-three-themes-vertical.mp4 --fps 30 --quality delivery
scripts.render:landscape: HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes render dist --composition landscape/index.html --output renders/one-interface-three-themes.mp4 --fps 30 --quality delivery
